thread:
maria_cs: FYI Cobalt AI onboarding — they're hitting higher than predicted traffic in APAC. Requested temporary rate bump + IP allowlist for their balance-of-payments demo. Renewal in 6w, flagging risk if we don't stabilize. What's feasible?

ashok_se: we can do a canary rate override. Need CIDR(s) & expected qps. suggest start 2x current qps for 48h w/ region pinned to ap-southeast-1. also what's their model? tokenizer size matters.

maria_cs: customer said ~350 qps sustained with spikes to 900 during demos. CIDRs: 203.0.113.0/24 and 2001:db8::/32. Model is gpt-large-open-8k. They want allowlist + rate window increase to reduce 429s.

lia_eng: ok. plan: add IPs to allowlist, create a per-tenant rate_limit_override + routing policy to apac. canary rollout: 10% traffic -> 30% -> 100% over 2h if no errors. warming autoscaler: pre-scale 2 nodes. config we'll apply:

```
{
  "tenant_id":"cobalt-ai",
  "rate_limit_override": {"qps":700, "burst":1200, "duration":"48h"},
  "ip_allowlist":["203.0.113.0/24","2001:db8::/32"],
  "region_pin":"ap-southeast-1",
  "canary":{"steps":[10,30,100],"step_duration":"40m"}
}
```

lia_eng: Also enabling prefix/KV cache for their frequent demos and setting model quantization profile to int8 for dedicated instances. I'll open a rollout PR and tag @ashok_se for approval.

ashok_se: ack. Please ensure that canary rollback criteria include >2% 5xx or >3% latency p95 regression. Also add a cost note to the ticket.

ops-bot: deploy job started: rollout/cobalt-allowlist-3387654321 (CI#8762).

maria_cs: I'll confirm with Cobalt and schedule a short enablement demo post-rollout. Marking renewal: medium risk -> improvement reduces risk. Thx team :thumbsup:

lia_eng: done — PR merged, autoscale prewarm scheduled. Monitoring dashboard: /dashboards/cobalt-ai/onboard. I'll post updates.

maria_cs: great. I'll update the customer and close loop. any follow-ups, ping me.
